title: Reproducible product screenshots from pinned demo data
summary: The 2026-08-09 operator decision makes the committed deterministic snapshot the source for documentation and marketing captures. AGT-2530 extends the ADR-0056 pipeline with a sanitized real-workspace export, a complete DEMO-9 decision state, two light/dark landing-page shot pairs, optional rendered annotations, and the --pinned source class across the manifest, backend parser, and UI. Task evidence retains --real, --mocked, and --composite. WEB-17 remains the follow-up for the website manifest-path and asset-sync update.
